name: Barcelona
headline: The grid, and one house in the Gothic Quarter.
summary: Three hotels at $150 or under for 10–11 November 2026, plus Hotel El Palace as the splurge.
intro: The Barcelona edit is three hotels whose Booking.com rate for 10–11 November 2026, two adults, was $150 or under, each with a score of 8.5 or higher. Concordia is in Sants-Montjuïc, Chi is on Gran Via by Rocafort, and Hamsa House is in the Gothic Quarter. Hotel El Palace, opened in 1919, is the splurge.
